title: NHAA Complaint Submission and Status Review Process
content: To submit an official complaint, provide your incident details, relevant dates, and supporting documents through the portal, designated intake desk, or assisted voice session. You will receive an acknowledgment reference ID within 24 hours. You can check the current status, assigned intake officer, and review timeline by entering your case reference in the portal or calling the status inquiry line.

title: Submitting Additional Supporting Documents or Information
content: If you need to attach more documentation, letters, or clarifications to an active complaint, visit the document upload section with your reference number. File formats accepted include PDF, JPEG, and scanned copies. If you are unable to upload digital copies, documents can be submitted at the local district support facilitation center.

title: शिकायत प्रक्रिया और स्थिति जांच निर्देश
content: अपनी शिकायत दर्ज करने के बाद आपको एक पावती संदर्भ संख्या (Case ID) प्राप्त होगी। शिकायत की स्थिति जानने के लिए पोर्टल पर संदर्भ संख्या दर्ज करें। यदि आपको दस्तावेज जमा करने या प्रक्रिया को आगे बढ़ाने में कोई कठिनाई आ रही है, तो नजदीकी सहायता केंद्र से संपर्क करें।

title: तक्रार नोंदणी आणि सद्यस्थिती तपासणी माहिती
content: तक्रार दाखल केल्यानंतर आपल्याला एक नोंदणी क्रमांक दिला जातो. आपल्या तक्रारीची सद्यस्थिती जाणून घेण्यासाठी किंवा नवीन कागदपत्रे जोडण्यासाठी या क्रमांकाचा वापर करावा. प्रक्रिया कशी पुढे न्यायची हे समजण्यास अडचण येत असल्यास ऑपरेटरची मदत उपलब्ध आहे.

title: Immediate Non-Clinical Emotional Support & Active Listening
content: For individuals experiencing acute worry, stress, or feeling overwhelmed during the complaint process, trained peer support listeners are available. This service provides a confidential, empathetic space to speak, organize your concerns, and receive guided referrals without clinical evaluation or judgment.

title: मानसिक ताण आणि संवादात्मक सहाय्य सेवा
content: जर तुम्हाला खूप ताण, काळजी किंवा दबाव जाणवत असेल आणि कोणाशी तरी बोलायचे असेल, तर संवादात्मक समुपदेशन व सहाय्य सेवा उपलब्ध आहेत. प्रशिक्षित सहाय्यक व्यक्ती परिस्थिती समजून घेऊन पुढील योग्य पावले उचलण्यास मदत करतात.

title: Community Psychosocial Counseling Referral Services
content: When complaints involve significant distress, prolonged anxiety, or disruption to daily functioning, intake operators can initiate a referral to recognized community-based counseling centers. Counselors provide coping strategies, stress reduction techniques, and personalized support planning.

title: Free Legal Aid Clinics & Representation Support
content: Citizens requiring legal guidance on their complaint rights, statutory protections, or formal representation can request a connection to the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) / District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) panel. Legal consultations are provided free of cost for eligible applicants.

title: Multilingual Vernacular Support & Assisted Intake
content: If you are more comfortable expressing your grievance in Hindi, Marathi, or other regional languages, translation facilitators and assisted intake staff are available. You may speak or write in your natural dialect, and our system will assist operators in understanding your core requirements accurately.

title: Immediate Safety Concern & Human Operator Escalation Protocol
content: When a statement indicates feelings of being unsafe, inability to maintain personal safety, or imminent threat, automated routing is prioritized for immediate senior human operator intervention. The operator will review the case without delay, verify the citizen's immediate security status, and coordinate appropriate protective and emergency support pathways.

title: Operator Intake Guidance: De-escalation and Active Listening
content: When handling high-stress complaints, operators should use calm, affirmative communication, validate the citizen's concerns, clearly explain each step of the resolution process, and ensure that safety signals receive immediate priority review ahead of procedural filing.

title: Complaint Resolution Timelines and Formal Follow-up Steps
content: Standard procedural complaints are reviewed within 15 working days. Priority high-distress or safety-flagged cases receive preliminary review within 24 hours. Citizens receive SMS and email status notifications at every stage of the resolution workflow.
